TC-17/S25.title: Web half of the clock check: wrong-clock browser shows the same Post-Round; summary edit stamped with server time
TC-17/S25.detail: pr-tc17-s25-clock.spec.ts (native half stays manual, device-only). Browser with clock +24 h in Pacific/Kiritimati: same note, completion, tasks and Tomorrow's Pre-Round Summary as the right-clock browser, both modes (pass); its stored session was treated as expired and it had to sign in again (B33). Saving an edited Tomorrow's Pre-Round Summary there stores nextPreRoundSummaryAt = device time: skew +86400 s vs server, Hospital and NH (FAILED, UAT 3.8 'server time, not device time'; TomorrowPreRoundSummaryCard.tsx:131 and snf PostRoundTab.tsx:102 write new Date() / nowIso()). Same root cause family as B18.
